why: The FS's own recreation-site record (EDW InfraRecreationSites, site 06T02, read 2026-11-20) places Blackrock Meadows in the Togwotee Snowmobile Trailhead: same spot, same directions ('15.5 miles ... turn left ... North side of the road and 0.5 miles before Togwotee Mountain Lodge'), and it describes the lot as 'This large parking area offers visitors access to numerous Snowmobile trails'. Under the curation doc's never-add rule, a campsite the agency places in a snowmobile parking area is out (Sproul SS016, AWH 2026-11-10). If AWH overrules, the add record below is complete.
name: Blackrock Meadows RV Camping Area
note: Bridger-Teton NF RV and camper-van area: a large open gravel lot on the north side of US 26/287 about 15 miles east of Moran Junction, half a mile west of Togwotee Mountain Lodge, entered straight off the highway. A summer camping area: in winter the lot is the Togwotee Snowmobile Trailhead. No campfires; self-contained rigs only. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Bridger-Teton NF camping page (read 2026-11-20), table 'RV and Camper Van Areas - Great for large RVs': 'Blackrock Meadows - No. First come, first served. - From Jackson, take Hwy 26/89 north to Moran then turn east towards Dubois. Drive 15 miles. The RV park will be on the left. - Large, flat area for RVs and vans. 15 miles from Grand Teton National Park. No campfires.'; FS designated-sites brochure (FS-authored 2025-03, hosted on visitjacksonhole.com) lists Blackrock Meadows at '50+' sites. Located from the FS EDW recreation-site layer (site 06T02 Togwotee Snowmobile Trailhead, 43.816376,-110.206672: 'head east on US 26/287 for approximately 15.5 miles then turn left ... North side of the road and 0.5 miles before Togwotee Mountain Lodge'; vault toilet, no water, no fee, open 24 hours, capacity 175) and a Jackson Hole camping guide ('Blackrock Meadows Trailhead & RV Camp is a dirt parking lot ... 15 miles east of Moran junction, or 1/2 mile west of Togwotee Mountain Lodge on the north side of HWY 26/287'). Esri imagery shows a ~250 x 90 m gravel lot with a camper and other vehicles parked, entered straight off the paved highway, no FS road needed. Not on recreation.gov (search 2026-11-20). -> agency-designated drive-in RV area (Moran Vista 6493 shape).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-20: Esri World_Imagery (rendered) at 43.81731,-110.20549 (~300 m frame) and at 43.81638,-110.20668 (~800 m frame, USFS road layer drawn on): open gravel lot in conifer forest north of US 26/287. Two small rectangular engineered ponds (by the lodge, apparently lagoons) sit ~90-120 m north behind a tree belt; Blackrock Creek is ~185 m south across the highway. No water body beside the lot -> not waterfront.
fees_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/recreation/camping-cabins (Blackrock Meadows row lists no fee, 'No. First come, first served.') + FS EDW recreation-site record 06T02 ('No fees are required for this site'), read 2026-11-20

booking.note: 14 nights within any 30-day period (forest-wide Order 04-03-328); Blackrock Meadows is not among the Blackrock RD areas under the 5-day summer limit of Order 04-03-24-204.

booking_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/recreation/camping-cabins ('No. First come, first served.'; 'You can camp in the Bridger-Teton National Forest for up to 14 days within any 30-day period') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/alerts/camping-5-day-stay-limit-jackson-blackrock-big-piney-greys-river-ranger (Order 04-03-24-204: Blackrock RD areas named are Toppings, Spread Creek, Pacific Creek and Colter Dump only) + recreation.gov search (no listing), read 2026-11-20
hookups_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/recreation/camping-cabins ('RV Camping: ... No hookups or dump stations are available, so RVs must be self-contained'), read 2026-11-20
facilities_source: FS EDW_RecInfraRecreationSites_02 record 06T02 Togwotee Snowmobile Trailhead (restroom_availability 'Vault toilet(s)', water_availability 'No water is available', 'A restroom is provided') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/recreation/camping-cabins ('No hookups or dump stations are available'), read 2026-11-20; imagery shows a small toilet building on the lot
flags: SNOWMOBILE-LOT RULE decides this skip: the FS camping page sells the place as an RV area ('Great for large RVs', 'The RV park will be on the left'), but the FS's own site record names the same lot the Togwotee Snowmobile Trailhead. It differs from Sproul SS016 in two ways: the FS lists it as an RV camping area, and snowmobile season does not overlap summer camping. If AWH reads the rule as covering only a site camped while it serves as snowmobile parking, change decision to 'add'. Every other gate passes.

ROAD LAYER (as asked): no FS road reaches the lot. It opens straight off paved US 26/287 (state highway; imagery shows the gravel entrance at the highway). USFS EDW_RoadBasic_01 (queried 2026-11-20) has only FR 30040 OLD TOGWOTEE HIGHWAY (ML2 'HIGH CLEARANCE VEHICLES') passing ~250 m NW and FR 30100 FLAGSTAFF-SPREAD CREEK (ML3) south of the creek; neither is the way in. So the ML2 question does not arise.
SITE COUNT not written: the FS brochure says '50+' (no exact figure); the FS site record gives capacity 175 (people at a trailhead, not campsites).
SEASON not written: no campground season is published (the site record says 'Open 24 hours/day').
PIN: the middle of the gravel lot, ~140 m NE of the FS trailhead point, which sits at the highway entrance.
PHONE: the FS camping page gives the Blackrock Ranger District as 307-543-3900; the 2025 brochure prints (307) 543-2386 (same discrepancy as lead 6).
Not in the DB: nothing within 8 km, and no Blackrock/Togwotee-named entry in WY.
curation_note: AWH 2026-11-20: add as a summer campground - the FS sells it as a summer RV area; the snowmobile-lot rule (Sproul SS016) applies to its winter trailhead use only. Phone sources differ (brochure 307-543-2386 vs district 307-543-3900). --Claude
